windows.notes: Round 4 b. Text: Tahoma 8 pt drawn unhinted at 10.8 px in grayscale against the capture's hinted ClearType, so glyph ink differs by up to 200 levels on text pixels and right ends of long captions differ by 0 to 2 px (strings with straight quotes up to 8 px over 60 characters); not a geometry error.
